title: Man Stabs Cop Multiple Times Before Being Shot by Bridgeport Officer
description:
* (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) *
Bridgeport, Connecticut — On Saturday, October 5, 2024, at approximately 1:00 a.m., Bridgeport Officers Marie Cetti, Jesse Jimenez, Maria Canhassi, and Jahmaine Mercer were dispatched to 147 Terry Place on a report of an emotionally disturbed person at that location. Upon arrival, the officers encountered 45-year-old Huntley Jackson. Officers, who were on the front porch of the residence spoke to Jackson, who was standing in the doorway of the front door. At one point, Jackson brandished a knife, ran onto the porch, and attacked Officer Cetti, cutting her in the shoulder, head, and neck. Officer Jimenez fired his weapon two times, striking Jackson in the torso. Both Jackson and Officer Cetti were taken to St. Vincent’s Hospital for treatment. Officer Cetti was treated and released. Jackson underwent surgery. His condition is listed as guarded but stable. Jackson was charged with Criminal Attempt to Commit Murder, Assault in the First Degree, and Assault on a Public Safety Officer. At arraignment, his bond was set at $750,000.
